title: शो-ऑफ स्कूटी, कॉलोनी डगमगाई! 🛵 | Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony | इंग्लिश कार्टून कॉमेडी
description:
Papa is determined to show off, so he buys a shiny scooty to beat the neighbour's bike. One wobbly ride later, the whole colony is queuing up to learn how to ride, and nobody is sure who is teaching whom! Watch the chaos of helmets, honking and borrowed balance as the colony finally gets its wheels under it. The lesson: a show-off ride can end in a lot of laughs and a few bruises. Hit subscribe for a new episode every week from Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony!
